summary: We developed iCrop, a web application that helps farmers around the world and near you! It finds the best crops to grow anywhere on Earth. By selecting a plot of land on a map, the app automatically pulls live NASA weather data and ISRIC soil information, matching those exact local conditions against a database of over 200 crops. It removes the guesswork from planting, provides rainfall overlays for smarter irrigation, and helps farmers prevent costly crop failures in harsh climates.
details: We built iCrop using modern architecture designed for speed and accuracy. For the frontend interface, we used Node.js, Tailwind CSS, and CesiumJS to render a smooth, interactive 3D globe where farmers can easily select their land and view spatial precipitation overlays. On the backend, Python powers our crop-matching engine, pulling live climate telemetry from the NASA POWER API alongside topsoil data from ISRIC SoilGrids. To ensure reliable recommendations, we calibrated our curated database of over 100 commercial crops using authoritative agronomic thresholds sourced from the FAO EcoCrop and USDA PLANTS databases. Our main goal is to empower farmers to accurately predict which crops are most suitable for them to grow on their fields.
